blocks.text: Bought. eBay, Ohio, $520 with a 25mm Switar that the seller
described as "cloudy" and is in fact fine. Spring holds 27 seconds, close
Arrived. Heavier than I expected. Smells like oil and
something older than oil. Serial puts it at 1956.
Loaded it wrong twice. The film has to go under the second
roller, not over, and no diagram makes this obvious.
Loading the Bolex H16 — Sprocket&Claw — Ep 002
Loaded it right. Wrote the steps down myself because the
video will not be there forever: open gate, thread under the sprocket
guard, loop of about eight frames above and below, engage both sprocket
teeth, close gate, wind two turns, check the counter moves.
First roll back from the lab. Twenty-two of twenty-eight
seconds are usable. The window one works.
